title: A dataset's table
description: The shape of the table an object owns (docs/unoverse/data/objects/dataset.md). The declaration IS the schema: the platform makes the table from it. Nobody writes SQL and nobody edits a database schema by hand.

description.description: What one row of this table is.

columns.description: The columns, in the order they are written. A name the platform puts on every dataset itself (id, org, of, document, created_at, updated_at) may not be declared here.

name.description: Lower case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter: a plain word that never has to be quoted.

type.description: `number` is exact decimal and never floating point, so a total that must reconcile against a stated figure does not drift.

required.description: A row without it is refused at the door.

indexed.description: Searched, filtered or grouped by, so the generated table indexes it.

description.description: What this column holds, in the words a reader of the data would use.

enum.description: The only values this column may hold. The database refuses anything else, so a word that IS the language (a measure, a unit, a side) cannot arrive misspelled and quietly become a second thing that never adds up with the first. Leave it off for a column that carries a document's own words, which are not ours to enumerate.

wordings.description: For a column with `enum`: the words a table's title or headings print for each value (net return: [performance, returns]), so a table found by its shape is known by what it holds. Each key is one of `enum`. Grows by approval (pipelines/tables.md 3b).

rowWordings.description: For a column with `enum`: the words a key-figures row's own label prints for each value (net asset value: [total net assets, fund size]), so one row of a label | value table is one figure. Each key is one of `enum`. Grows by approval (pipelines/tables.md 3b).

columnWordings.description: For a column with `enum`: the words a table's column prints for each value (exposure: [market value, of net assets]), so a number kept from any table is known by the column it sits under when its table's title names none. Each key is one of `enum`. Grows by approval (pipelines/tables.md 3f).

values.description: For a column with `enum`: the values of another column each of its values gathers (a dimension's own categories: fair value level: [Level 1, Level 2, Level 3]), so a number whose row or column names one is known to be sliced that way. Each key is one of `enum`. Grows by approval (pipelines/tables.md 3i).

uniqueBy.description: The columns that together identify one row, so a read again replaces its rows rather than landing beside them and counting a reading twice.

subject.description: The column that says WHOSE these rows are. The one row this dataset leaves on the map is titled from it; the platform never guesses the word.

asOf.description: The column that says when these rows speak as of, so the handle can say it.

whose.description: Whose a row is, as records (pipelines/tables.md 3i step 4): the object a row's subject is, its parts, how one sits inside another, and the `level` value each is filed under. The platform names no industry: the org says its subject is a fund, a store, a client.

object.description: The object a row's subject is (fund).

column.description: The column its name goes in (fund).

level.description: The `level` value for the subject's own figures (fund).

names.description: The subject's field of other names (alsoKnownAs).

compare.description: The subject's field naming what it is compared with (benchmark).

compareLevel.description: The `level` value for that comparison's figures (index).

within.description: How a subject sits inside another: the link to its parent (subFundOf) and the field naming the parent (umbrella).

part.description: Its parts (a fund's share classes): their object, column, `level` value, name field and the field naming their subject.

none.description: The `level` value for a document about no subject (market).

relative.description: The measures that are a subject's figure against its comparison (excess return: the return above the benchmark's): a row of one that names no subject of its own is the subject the table's own rows name, when they name exactly one; with two or more it names none. Each is one of the measure column's `enum`.

vehicles.description: The words a name of the subject's kind carries when it names one (fund; a segregated portfolio's portfolio): an allocation table's row whose name holds one of them, with words of its own, is a holding, a line from the subject to it (pipelines/tables.md 3c rule 3); a row of words alone is a heading. Absent, the word fund.

terms.description: The measures that are a record's standing terms, never figures over time (fee): a rate of one is a field of the subject's or part's record, read by the layout, and never a row; an amount of money of one (fees charged over a period) stays a row. Each is one of the measure column's `enum`.
